enemies.name: Desert Bandit
enemies.text: Raiders of the desert roads who prey on villages and travellers. A bandit raises his blade before he strikes — step back or roll behind him while it is up, then punish.

enemies.name: Jackal
enemies.text: A lean desert hunter that circles and lunges with a quick bite. Its wind-up is short, so watch for the crouch and dash out of the lunge.

enemies.name: Giant Scorpion
enemies.text: Armoured from the front: blows to its shell do little, and a stun will not stop its sting. Its wind-up is long — roll behind it and strike its back.

enemies.name: Desert Archer
enemies.text: A bandit with a short bow who keeps his distance and backs away when you close in. A yellow glint on the arrowhead means the arrow is about to fly — block it, parry it back at him as it arrives, roll through it or jump over it, then run him down.

enemies.name: The Brass Collector
enemies.text: A hulking golem of brass and sandstone with a cage on its back — the Laboratory's catcher of people. Its blows are slow and heavy: roll out of the sweep, jump over the shockwave of its slam, and keep hitting — only a long chain breaks its stance.

enemies.name: The Fire Djinn
enemies.text: A burning spirit on a tail of smoke and flame, born in the Laboratory's cells. It claws up close and hurls fire from afar; a glowing mark on the floor means a pillar of fire is coming — step off it. Wounded, it fights faster and throws twice.
